bg: A wide 16:9 view inside a vintage mountain train dining car: small tables with white cloths and little lamps, red leather seats, big windows on both sides showing green mountains and pine forest, a wooden serving counter with a coffee machine on the left, a door to the next car at the back, warm morning light.

chars.desc: an adult woman chief train conductor named Ms. Kaur, Indian, brown skin, long black hair in a neat braid, a navy conductor uniform with gold buttons, a red conductor cap, a silver ticket punch on a chain
an adult man train chef named Mr. Szabo, Hungarian, light skin, a short grey beard, a white chef coat and small chef hat, a tea towel over his shoulder
printed train timetable board in a wooden frame with station names and times
an adult man named Mr. Novak, Czech, light skin, short brown hair, a tweed jacket, a long red scarf, a leather bag covered in old train badges
an older woman named Mrs. Castillo, Mexican, tan skin, curly grey hair, glasses, a green cardigan, holding knitting needles and blue wool
a 14 year old boy named Benji, Nigerian, dark brown skin, short hair, a grey hoodie, big headphones around his neck, a phone
